spec.prompt: createWarning crashes with an unhelpful TypeError ('code.toUpperCase is not a function') when code is not a string, and silently accepts a non-string name or message. Validate them: a present but non-string name, code or message should throw an Error saying which field must be a string.
spec.requirement: createWarning throws new Error(`Warning ${field} must be a string`) (field = name, code or message) when that field is present (truthy) but not a string. Missing or empty fields keep the existing 'Warning <field> must not be empty' errors. Valid input behaves as before.
spec.adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit; behaviour outside the requirement is not graded.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev split only)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: code: 123 throws an Error with message 'Warning code must be a string'
name: {} throws 'Warning name must be a string'
message: 42 throws 'Warning message must be a string'
empty or missing fields still throw 'Warning <field> must not be empty'
valid string fields create a working warning
